definitions.explanation: A form of gambling where numbered tickets are sold and winners are selected by drawing. Also refers to the ticket itself.

examples.japanese: {宝|たから}くじで{三|さん}{等|とう}が{当|あ}たった。
examples.english: I won third prize in the lottery.

examples.japanese: {年末|ねんまつ}ジャンボ{宝|たから}くじは{毎年|まいとし}{大|おお}きな{話題|わだい}になる。
examples.english: The year-end Jumbo Lottery becomes a big topic every year.

notes:
USAGE:
One of the most popular forms of legal gambling in Japan. Tickets are sold at dedicated lottery booths ({宝|たから}くじ{売|う}り{場|ば}) often found near train stations. Major drawings include the year-end Jumbo ({年末|ねんまつ}ジャンボ) and Summer Jumbo (サマージャンボ).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宝|たから}くじを{買|か}う (to buy a lottery ticket)
- {宝|たから}くじが{当|あ}たる (to win the lottery)
- {宝|たから}くじ{売|う}り{場|ば} (lottery ticket booth)
- {宝|たから}くじに{外|はず}れる (to lose the lottery)

WRITING:
Also written as {宝籤|たからくじ}, but the mixed kana/kanji spelling {宝|たから}くじ is standard.
